about_the_game:
‌Important Notice:‌ All characters in this game are 18 years of age or older.

"Wage Life" is a game that mainly focuses on job training, simulation management, and romantic adventures.

The sudden accident left you in great need of money after you just lost your job.

Work in factories, apply phone films, carry bricks and mix mortar, serve in nightclubs, set up stalls for barbecues. Use every means possible that you can manage.

Experience the hard work in society and feel the various pressures one has to bear to stay alive.

This is a part-time job life that belongs to you.

Story Summary:

One misfortune followed another: unemployment, a family member's serious illness. The weight of life suddenly came crashing down.

A misfortune may turn out to be a blessing in disguise.

Mysterious nightclub girls, melancholy single mothers, struggling part-time students, hardworking factory workers, passionate clinic nurses - there are always surprising encounters in daily life.

Returning to a small city doesn't mean failure; it's just a temporary rest on the journey of life.

But the prerequisite is to work hard.

So, let's start working. Money is absolutely essential.

After all, 80 percent of the difficulties in life can be solved with money.

 

Game Features:

Exquisite and beautiful original paintings in Japanese hand-drawn art style.

Dialect dubbing with Chinese regional characteristics.

Experience the five heroines' spectacular story feasts in the gameplay guide.

A fun and engaging simulation business game featuring various part-time job modes. These include: mobile phone screen protection, construction site work, nightclub service, street vending of barbecued food, and working in a factory to tighten screws, etc.
